answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake, then slash stakes when independent audits verify coordinated reward manipulation using signed messages and payment flows. New names or keys do not erase shared-control evidence, but penalties should require proof, not mere similarity. The attacker must lock up capital for every fake identity and risks losing it; a garden or meadow of cheap bots becomes expensive, while a public lantern-like audit trail lets others check the case.
